title: lauren

quiz.question: What does the word 'abhor' mean?
options: To fall asleep because something is super boring.

quiz.question: What does the word 'elicit' mean?
options: A beast with an elephant head on a smaller elephant's body.

quiz.question: If an object travels at 3 feet per second, how many feet does it travel in one hour?
quiz.question_short: 3 feet per second. How many feet in an hour?
options: Trick question! Objects don't have 3 feet! Burned!

quiz.question: Which of the following is a factor of the sum of 15 + 45?
quiz.question_short: A factor of the sum of 15 + 45?

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
quiz.question_short: NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
options: Me! I am not a multiple of 9 + 3!

quiz.question: If n + 1 = 25, what is the value of 3n + 3?
A number is divided by 4. The result is divided by 4, which equals 2. What was the original number?
quiz.question_short: Number divided by 4. Result divided by 4 to get 2. Original number?
options: I'm too smart to answer such easy questions.

quiz.question: What does the word 'fathom' mean?
options: To get a question wrong in a quiz.

quiz.question: What does the word 'gratuitous' mean?
options: Spitting everywhere like a camel. In short, not cool.

quiz.question: What does the word 'hackneyed' mean?
options: We couldn't think of anything for this... Wink. Wink.

quiz.question: What does the word 'iconoclast' mean?
options: One who can transform into a robot.
One who is really good with a computer.

nodes.text: Lauren decorates the car quickly, faster than all the other pranksters.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hey, this is pretty fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're really getting the hang of it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Michael, your girlfriend is totally smoking you! She's amazing!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What? No way! I can beat her!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: There's no way you can beat me, Slowpoke!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I were a betting man, I'd bet on Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, she's a natural!
Lauren sprints across the street, leaping over bushes and trash bins...
She's the first to jump into the get-away car!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I've never seen `anyone` run that fast. You sure you're not part cheetah?
nodes.text_bbcode: I've never seen [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone[/i][/color] run that fast. You sure you're not part cheetah?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll beat you next time!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Sure you will...
Hector and Howard arrive, wheezing and gasping.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait for us!
He knows he has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Lauren lags behind $Michael, stumbling over trash bins and crashing into bushes.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lauren, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Go on without me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No way! Come on, grab my hand!
Lauren grabs $Michael's hand, and he pulls her into the car!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, look at the lovebirds...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Move it or lose it, guys!
Lauren decorates the car way too slowly... Nothing is getting done on her end.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Argh... I just can't do this right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Lauren, are you slowing us down?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, I'm just kidding. Work at your own pace!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Every prankster has to start somewhere... You'll get the hang of it.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How about I help you?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Please and thank you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are we doing the whole car, or...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can cover the upper half, but nothing that might damage the car.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're pranksters with honor, after all.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! Unlike the vulture...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hold up. So why are we pranking `Jacob?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold up. So why are we pranking [color=#3b78e2][i]Jacob?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dating and dumping Allison right before the dance, just to get back at Alexei... That was ten levels of messed up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `And` he ditched us for the jocks!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] he ditched us for the jocks!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Dude, we're jocks, too.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He ditched us for the `other` jocks!
nodes.text_bbcode: He ditched us for the [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] jocks!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: True.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I thought he was your friend...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He `was,` past tense. He pranked outside the group!
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#e23b3b][i]was,[/i][/color] past tense. He pranked outside the group!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Pranking without us... Pranking just to be mean... What he did was `not` cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pranking without us... Pranking just to be mean... What he did was [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] cool.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And he shouldn't have treated Allison like that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anyone who betrays the code of pranksters...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Deserves to get pranked!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow, I guess there really is honor among pranksters.
You are now playing as Lauren.
The prank team descends on their target under the cover of night...
Only one light can be seen in Jacob's house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Out of the car! Go, go, go!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The vulture has landed!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, we know. But what's he doing?
$Scott squints at his phone...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He's eating cheese puffs on the couch, watching reality TV. Our informant says that now's our chance!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Informant?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Jacob's sister.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She's a delightfully vengeful middle schooler. Easily bribed with food.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We've got... Ten minutes before commercial break. Go!
$Michael and Lauren dash toward the bushes opposite Jacob's driveway!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Queen Elizabeth is on the throne...
The pranksters wait with bated breath...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, coast's clear! Get out there, guys!
The pranksters jump out into the open!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everyone got supplies? Cover as much of the car as you can.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I've got to move fast!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hm... Wise choice. Not too destructive, but definitely attention grabbing.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It'll be the talk of the school!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, the vulture deserves it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man, you've got a vicious streak... But I like it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Expired bologna, it is.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, the vulture deserves it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Interesting choice, my friend. It's a good thing I bought the value sized pack.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The vulture sure is getting what he deserves...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, try this... 'Harriet Tubman's chilling by the fireplace.'

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That means, uh... Stay put.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You got it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if I say... 'Ready the firecrackers?'

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That means... Run!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude, she got it faster than $Michael did.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Heh, that's right.
Hector fist bumps Lauren.
Just as Lauren's getting The Code...
$Scott's phone buzzes. He checks it, only to find out that...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Jacob, er, the vulture is landing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What, already?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, everyone into the car!
In the car, the prank team discusses their plan of attack...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So the vulture's, er, wings are in a vulnerable position! Now is the time to strike!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: His car is parked and he's nowhere in sight.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's what I said!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Eyes on the prize, guys. What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're going to decorate the vulture's sweet ride with... What've we got, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sparkly streamers, saran wrap, and bologna.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Can I just `eat` the bologna?
nodes.text_bbcode: Can I just [color=#e23b3b][i]eat[/i][/color] the bologna?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. It's expired.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aw... Can we decorate with all of them?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've got to pick one. Multiple decorations is an amateur prank move.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think, $Michael?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I pick...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh, I think I get it.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wait, I thought `explosions` meant go.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, I thought [color=#3b78e2][i]explosions[/i][/color] meant go.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, I think I messed it up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, $Michael. I thought you understood our arcane and honored code... How wrong I was.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoops.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow, Slowpoke, can't even get your own code right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What $Michael should have said is that Benjamin Franklin means stay in place.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So explosions mean go, and historical figures mean stay put. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yup!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It means...?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Er, I forgot what I was saying.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My beloved bro, you are an embarrassment to all brokind.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So explosions mean go, and historical figures mean stay put. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yup!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That means...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Kaboom! Then that means...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yes...?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry, so, uh, if I say Benjamin Franklin...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And you being shunned at school... That's sort of my fault.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It's not. That's their problem, not yours.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But you shouldn't have to suffer for it.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It sucks, but I'm okay. I don't need you to be my knight in shining armor.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm not looking to rescue you, or anything. I just want to make things a little better.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah. It'd be cool for my favorite people to be friends. You know what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You'll like my friends, once you get to know them.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Fine, fine. You win, Slowpoke.
When the weekend rolls around, Lauren meets $Michael and the guys in the Centerscore High parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Lauren.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Um, hey.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You okay? You seemed kind of upset last time at $Michael's house...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I was just surprised by the whole pranking thing... Those trophies were huge to me, you know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, that was us...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude, that was not our best moment...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry about the trophy room, Lauren. We shouldn't have done that...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Apology accepted...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now that that's settled... You guys ready to right some wrongs?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What are we doing?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Pranking Jacob, of course. We'll explain along the way...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Howard, you got the supplies?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I got a ton so we'd have options.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll be lookout this time.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Do a better job than Hector, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man, that's setting the bar low. If you don't fall asleep, then you're good.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It was only the one time... I didn't mean to let the teachers catch you...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're just playing! We love you, man.
A car door slams shut!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You guys ready? We gotta roll.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Uh, sure...
$Michael gives Lauren a thumbs-up.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Okay, I'm game! Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But first... You have to learn The Code.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: The Code? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem! Created in 1792 by George Washington, our revered pranking code has been passed down from generation to generation for centuries.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, $Scott made up the Code during chemistry class last year.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Such epic beginnings...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: We use The Code when we have to communicate stuff secretly... Plus, it's just really cool.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So historical figures mean stay in place, and explosions mean go.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So, for example, if I say...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Really? `Those` guys?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? [color=#3b78e2][i]Those[/i][/color] guys?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: When I started school at Centerscore, I was the new guy and didn't have any friends.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Sort of like me right now...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But they befriended me, and brought me into their group. They joke around, sure, but they really care. They don't like to see people left out, or shunned.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: They're my best friends now... I mean, besides you.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Aw, $Michael.
Lauren scootches closer to $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You're going to bring that up? Now?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I broke it off with you for good reason. You guys wrecked the trophy room for kicks!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It was for revenge! Wilson High stole our playbooks, remember?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Two wrongs don't make a right.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know, but... Look, my friends are important to me.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Your friends consoled you when your mean Wilson High girlfriend broke your heart. Big whoop.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Can't you just give them a second chance?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Give `them` a second chance? No, I think even giving `us` a second chance was a mistake.
nodes.text_bbcode: Give [color=#3b78e2][i]them[/i][/color] a second chance? No, I think even giving [color=#3b78e2][i]us[/i][/color] a second chance was a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: We're done, $Michael. This is over.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But we can still make this work!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: No, we can't.
Lauren gets up, leaving $Michael behind...
$Michael is alone now...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's just that... Well, I thought you and my friends would really get along.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Really? I'm not so sure about that.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: They're pranksters, sure, but they're also really great guys.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Huh. How so?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: They're great guys because they were there for me when...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: The trophy room was really special to me. It had my track trophies in it... You know that.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Not sorry enough to think that maybe... Maybe I don't want to be friends with the jerks who flooded the trophy room!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of that...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You are?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I didn't realize it would hurt you like that.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It's... It's okay. I was just surprised.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know it's tough at your school right now, so I thought it would help if you had some friends outside school...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks for thinking of me, at least.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Remember at the Kiss and Make Up Dance, how I said I didn't care what anybody else thought about me? I meant that, but...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I... I lost all my track friends when I decided to date you. I'm still being shunned at school.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wait, still? Why didn't you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I didn't want you to think that I regretted choosing you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: They weren't very good friends anyway...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But it shouldn't be this way.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Well, I can't just wish on a shooting star for things to get better. This is life.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm just going to have to deal with it. It just sucks.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: There's got to be a better solution...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You're not my fairy godmother. You can't just conjure up friends for me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, I can't? That sounds like a challenge.
Lauren laughs as they head toward the car.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Challenge `accepted.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Challenge [color=#e23b3b][i]accepted.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The next day...
The prank team guys gather at $Michael's house after school to game the day away!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Everyone got a controller?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $Michael, this is `amazing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: $Michael, this is [color=#e23b3b][i]amazing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The graphics, the motion sensing, the story framing... I think I'm in love!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So when's Lauren getting here?
The sound of the doorbell rings through the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Speak of the, uh, girlfriend.
Lauren walks into the room...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hey $Michael! Are you going to introduce me?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So this is $Scott, and this is Howard. And that's Hector weeping tears of joy over the console.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Same. So have you guys started yet?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Nah, we were waiting for you.
Gaming commences...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hector! We're losing to the sky kraken!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Argh, what do we do? I only have two lives left.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Whoever said you only live once was so, so wrong.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We need a strategy to beat this quest.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Right. Like a diversion to draw off the enemy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Scott and Howard, you guys can distract the guards while Lauren and I retrieve the treasure.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Why not fight head on? Why distract the guards?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Distracting others is our standard strategy... In game and in real life.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It always works!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: In real life?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, like when we flipped all the chairs in homeroom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When we covered the lawn in stuffed animals...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And when we flooded the trophy room!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That was you guys...?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Those trophies were important to me! It broke my heart to see the trophy room in ruins!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, dude, really?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael, I can't. I just can't deal with this right now.
Lauren leaves, slamming the door behind her!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aw, man...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aren't you going to go after her?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Should I?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on. It's practically your duty.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I think I know where to find her...
$Michael makes straight for the local park and finds Lauren sitting in the playground tunnel.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lauren!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael? How did you find me?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know you love this park. It's where we first met...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It's the best park for running laps.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: A local treasure. So... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I... I just couldn't handle being with your friends. Knowing they were the ones who flooded the trophy room...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, about my friends being the prank team...

options.label: I thought you were over it...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I love her and she loves me. That's more than you can say about your... Your followers!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey! We're not followers!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Yeah! We do what `we` want when `we` want!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! We do what [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] want when [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] want!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Shut up, you guys! I'm talking.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry, Alexei! We'll do whatever you say, bro!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: We don't care what you or anyone else at Wilson High thinks!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It's none of your business, Alexei. Step off.
$Michael puts his arm around Lauren.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Man, this stinks! Let's go.
Alexei and his friends storm off.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I hope you don't have to deal with that all the time...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: We'll beat you next time, lizard!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, right.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Guys, let's get out of here. We don't hang around lizard losers.
Alexei and his friends stomp off. The smell of deodorant and bitterness lingers behind.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael, `I'm` from Wilson High...
nodes.text_bbcode: $Michael, [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] from Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But you're not like them!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Still. I'll always root for Wilson High. We lost to you guys, sure, but you didn't have to rub it in.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I didn't mean to do that.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I know, but next time? Just don't. I still care about my school, even if my school doesn't care about me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But I thought...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm looking forward to our dinner date. I'm `starving.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm looking forward to our dinner date. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]starving.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Come on, let's go.
In the parking lot, $Michael and Lauren spot a familiar face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Isn't that... Alexei's sister?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I think so. Either that, or her evil clone twin.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: She looks pretty down...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: The last time I saw her, she had good reason to be...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well, Jacob dated and dumped her at the Kiss and Make Up Dance just to get back at Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Ugh, that sucks.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I wish there was something I could do about it.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What's done is done...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: True. Ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I... I think I see some people from Wilson High...
A group of guys pull into the parking lot...
It's the guys from the Wilson High track team!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Man...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You guys!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hi Alexei... And Steve... And Darren...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Yeah! This is Wilson High turf.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Uh, this is private property, not anyone's so-called turf.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: The traitor speaks!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Excuse me? I go to Wilson High just like you!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: But you're always out with this Centerscore loser!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Look, our schools are rivals, not warring nations. If you haven't noticed, there's a `huge` difference between the two.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, our schools are rivals, not warring nations. If you haven't noticed, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] difference between the two.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: And I date who I want! You don't get a say in what I do.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Hey $Michael...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What's it like to go on a date with a Wilson High traitor?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I have to stand up to Alexei! What do I say?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: At least...

options.label: We lizards didn't lose to you badgers!

nodes.text: Michael swings his putter and gives the ball a light tap.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, shoot...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow, I'm not sure you even hit the ball.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Can I have a do-over?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Nope. I can taste the caviar already!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, your turn...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Back up, $Michael. I'm going to do my Ultimate Power Move!
Stepping back, Lauren sinks the putt perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I win! Well, I guess you're buying me dinner!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes... But that was my plan all along!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Sure it was.
$Michael swings his golf club and the ball sails past the windmill and volcano...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Look at that! It went right in.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I admit it... You're pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Your turn!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Watch and learn, darling.
Lauren swings...
And the ball wobbles off course and into a ditch.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Well, that's that. You win, fair and square.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Just barely... You're a worthy opponent, Lauren.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Aw, thanks!
$Michael swings his golf club and the ball flies away...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Argh! Did you see where it landed?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I think... I think it went into the water. Ew.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll go fish it out.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You know this is `mini`-golf, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: You know this is [color=#3b78e2][i]mini[/i][/color]-golf, right?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh, whoops

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: So... You're buying me dinner.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yep! You still in the mood for filet mignon?
$Michael swings his golf club... And nearly misses the ball.
It rolls two inches and comes to a stop.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow, I really need better aim...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Move aside... I'll show you how a pro does it.
Stepping back, Lauren sinks the putt perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lauren, you're incredible.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks. You're not so bad yourself, champ.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So dinner's on me?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Sure is! You'll beat me someday, grasshopper...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I will! Just you wait...

nodes.text: Mission accomplished!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sweet! Group bro hug!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, everyone and their mother knows about our prank.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Won't Jacob try to get back at us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nah, he won't... He knows that what he did to Allison was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That's pretty cool of you guys...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Actually, we're not cool...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When we pranked Wilson High, we didn't consider who might get hurt. We just wanted to get back at the guys who stole our playbooks...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We could have pranked better, pranked smarter.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, pranking is supposed to be fun, not harmful!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What we did was `not` cool. We were just as bad as Jacob, in a way.
nodes.text_bbcode: What we did was [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] cool. We were just as bad as Jacob, in a way.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Turning your trophy room into a fish tank was funny, but it wasn't right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Which is why we want to present `you` with a trophy.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Which is why we want to present [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] with a trophy.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To make up for the trophy room we ruined... This trophy goes to you, Lauren.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now you can start your own trophy room!

nodes.speaker: Lauren

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Best Prankster!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And we're adding a new rule to our constitution of pranking, in your honor... Prank for good, not for evil.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks, guys!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, thank `you,` for giving $Michael another chance. He would have been heartbroken without you...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, thank [color=#e23b3b][i]you,[/i][/color] for giving $Michael another chance. He would have been heartbroken without you...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know it's true...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, she's the best girlfriend a guy could have...

nodes.text: This place looks an awful lot like the golf course!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whatever! Everyone ready to paintball?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Only the strongest will survive!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everyone got their paintball weapon of choice?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yep!

$Michael pulls her aside!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What...?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Shhhh... We're getting out of here!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: We are?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Come on, I heard this new ramen restaurant opened up down the street.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I `have` been craving ramen lately.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] been craving ramen lately.

nodes.text: Do you think the guys will notice we're gone?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: In the heat of paintball war? Not likely.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You know... Sneaking out together... It's just like old times...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: We had a lot of fun, keeping our relationship a secret...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm glad we're a `real` couple now, out in the open... But you'll always be the Romeo to my Juliet...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Though Romeo and Juliet `was` a tragedy...
nodes.text_bbcode: Though Romeo and Juliet [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a tragedy...

nodes.text: Stepping closer to Lauren, $Michael leans in for a kiss...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You know what? I think our story's going to last a lot longer than some play...
Hand in hand, $Michael and Lauren walk down the street together...

So... Thanks for, well, pranking Jacob. It's nice to know that there are people out there like you.
Wow, I had no idea that was going on... Are you okay?

That's what friends are for, right?

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
